== Summary ==
Players Committee card image of [[The Shield Will Be Down In Moments / Imperial Troops Have Entered The Base! (AI)]] (Original), as published: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2494181434fdfa411310a5b0e0d0aa18ef8b64de/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual22-Dark/large/theshieldwillbedowninmoments_ai.gif Holotable image repository, commit 2494181] “Set 22”, 1 October 2023. Uploaded unchanged (byte-for-byte copy of that commit's file; the PC stores it as PNG data under a .gif name, so it is uploaded here with a .png extension). Later replaced at the same address by the next version's image.

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/99/V22-D-theshieldwillbedowninmoments_ai-original.png Internet Archive item].
